title: Golden Filipino Frittata
description: A twist on the classic frittata, incorporating Filipino flavors. Perfect for a hearty breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: golden potatoes
ingredients.notes: Try to use high-starch potatoes for fluffiness

ingredients.name: filipino longganisa
ingredients.notes: Replace with regular sausage for a different flavor

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: Fresh eggs for the best results

ingredients.name: frittata
ingredients.notes: Garnish with fresh herbs for a pop of color

instructions: In a large skillet, sauté diced tomatoes and potatoes in a little oil until they're tender.
Add sliced longganisa and cook until browned.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the egg mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro, if using.
Let the frittata rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
